# Selected projects

::: {.project-list}
### Elastic Net for Large-Scale NYC Taxi Trip Prediction
**STAT 8672 · Georgia State University · Spring 2026**

Built a large-scale predictive modeling workflow using NYC TLC Yellow Taxi data. Compared ridge, lasso, and elastic-net models with `glmnet`, emphasizing regularization, validation, and scalable statistical learning.

**Tools:** R · glmnet · data preprocessing · model validation

### Longitudinal Response-Profile Analysis of Whole Brain Volume
**STAT 8540 · Georgia State University · Spring 2026**

Analyzed normalized whole-brain volume in the OASIS cohort using longitudinal response-profile methods, with attention to repeated measurements and appropriate covariance modeling.

**Tools:** R · longitudinal models · GLS · statistical inference

### Bayesian Computation: Monte Carlo & Gibbs Sampling
Implemented simulation-based Bayesian analyses using Monte Carlo and Gibbs-sampling methods, with reproducible R workflows and posterior summaries.

**Tools:** R · Bayesian inference · Monte Carlo · Gibbs sampling

### Numerical Optimization
Implemented and studied optimization methods including golden-section search, steepest descent, conjugate-gradient methods, Newton/Levenberg-Marquardt ideas, and constrained optimization.

**Tools:** R/Python · numerical methods · optimization

### Time-Series Causality in a Machine-Learning Framework
Graduate research exploring causality detection in time-series data using machine-learning approaches, contributing to later work on reservoir-computing causality and brain connectivity.

**Tools:** Python · machine learning · time series · reservoir computing
:::
